summary: Black Hills Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to $183.4 million of common stock for an at-the-market (ATM) offering under an existing sales agreement. The filing updates the registration statement after prior sales of $216.6 million under a $400 million program. Shares are sold through agents BofA, BMO, Mizuho, MUFG, RBC as agents/forward sellers; proceeds are received only upon physical settlement of forward agreements. This is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable; watch for ordinary market sales and potential dilution.
